method: Read the original NRRD with pynrrd index_order=F, count every stored integer value, intersect nonzero values with the delivered LUT in LUT order, and retain each original named value without unions. No model rasterization, interpolation, re-registration or hemispheric partition.

source_grid.image_grid_correspondence: Same-volunteer MRI and source labels. Their affine origins differ by 0.5 mm on each world axis; each native grid is retained. No additional registration is applied.

classification_note: Eligibility and category are project routing buckets based on explicit source names. They do not create new anatomical boundaries or claim an independent medical review. Whole source optic nerves may include extracranial extent and are kept separately flagged.

vtk_only_plan: Create an independent native surface-source configuration from explicitly referenced original VTK POLYDATA and source atlasStructure-all.json/MRML model names. Preserve source points, cells, original transforms and source units; compare bounds and MRML correspondence before claiming MRI registration. Select the canonical DataSource reference where duplicate numeric labels occur and retain provenance for each alternative. Existing adapters do not ingest VTK directly, so add a tested source reader/adapter rather than rasterizing or inventing volume voxels. Keep the existing spl_nac and new named-volume configuration available independently.
